goal: Make the typed task 'open the cabinet door' and then, as a separate task in the same node, 'close the cabinet door' both succeed on the real Kinova Gen3 bench, leaving the door as it was found, reliably and fast, without hardcoding this cabinet, within the safety scope of docs/auto-research.md.

arm.description: The one physical Kinova Gen3 and its sheppy adl node.

evaluation.run.description: One attended hardware cycle: operator GO, node restart on this worktree, reset, the open task, then the close task in the same node; scored by stages and by the evaluator's own wrist-camera depth check of the door.

guard.offline.description: No-motion guardrail: pinned safety files, unit tests, design check, live plan-only through every send gate.

workflow.agent: Read docs/auto-research.md and the last cycle's first_failure, door fractions, open/close halves and node_log_tail. Make one scoped change with its unit test, commit it, then resume.
